title: Instant Explode TNT
body:
# Yes this datapack only does that
It only works on tnt that is nearby entities! 
(btw it isnt so instant, it sets the tnt explosion time to 1 tick not 0 ticks, doesnt make a difference though.)
It works instantly after adding it into the world, so be cautious when adding it into already existing worlds.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Dc3fI7kn/images/b173a0b296aeab4992b134fcae4cb4e3edb8dcc6.gif)

I DIDNT KNOW THAT SOMEONE ALREADY MADE THIS FOR 1.21.1-1.21.3 [GO SHOW THEM SOME LOVE](https://modrinth.com/datapack/instant-tnt)
